assessment_scope.source_boundary: Two curated reviewed items on re-zero:beatrice@light-novel at basis_commit, both read in full: #character-model, the canonical generation V1.0 Beatrice V01-V15 source-bounded model of the admitted original-Japanese main light novels (Beatrice first encountered in V02), which declares forty-seven bounded Japanese reread windows rather than fifteen whole rereads and keeps historical Meyer testimony, reached through Shima's fragment-derived V14 account, and Beatrice-owned memory separately attributed; and #estate-story-checkpoint, the frozen V02-V03 estate-story synthesis, whose Beatrice content is one paragraph (section 6) and its section 10 statement that she remained an accumulation case at V03. The curated #master-longitudinal-ledger was not read and is not cited. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, gate and horizon only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Beatrice fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence here and nothing is borrowed from them; V16 and later, IF, web-novel, supplement and adaptation material is excluded.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's required default is living RZ-E-018 at the V15 p-027#B0216 month-later party, dancing with Petra after the chosen contract, with the old reserve spent, Puck dormant and the library gone; its explicit selectable phases are the represented historical Meyer household, the V02 initial mansion encounters, the surviving V03 estate week (RZ-E-008), the superseded E010 grief/refusal, E012 evacuation refusal, E013 guarded library exchange, E014 rescue/book assertion and E017 blank-book/death request, the E018 waiting and repeated refusals, the chosen hand and first battle, and the private Roswaal recognition. The four-century past is undated, failed-state episodes are not her default memories, and the evidence ends at V15 although the project's sequential analysis has continued beyond it.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1 states a governing interpretation (the library is at once work, room, sanctuary, inherited purpose and access control; the guarded place is not the whole life) and section 4 separates what she protects and wants, what she fears and misreads, and a dependency that is not total passivity; twenty-eight conditional rules BE15-R01-R28 carry trigger, state, interpretation, priority, exception and confidence, and section 10 tests twelve rival collapses (all hostility is hidden affection, the book made her feelings fake, pure victimhood or pure self-confinement) against located counterevidence. Motive accounts are partly attributed (R03, the B011 focal inference), the mother's intention and the old contract are unresolved, and it is one same-analyst artifact whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; the explicit rival adjudication and conditioned motive conflicts exceed specialist interpretation alone, so C is not supported.

Section 2.1 maps eleven phases from the represented Meyer household to the V15 party, each with what must not leak into it, and the source shows enacted change rather than persistence: early painful mana interference and touch refusals (B002, B005), the bounded E007 protection contract (B007-B008), repeated E018 refusals (B028), the chosen hand and naming (B029) and the depleted post-contract state (B030); the checkpoint independently records that at V03 her contracts and history were still materially incomplete. The four-century past is undated and partly reached through a fragment-derived account, failed-state phases are separately bounded rather than continuous, and the evidence stops at V15, so A is not supported; development is located phase by phase with explicit firewalls, so C is not supported.

Section 9 gives seventeen register rows conditioned on addressee and speech act: familiar ベティー versus formal ベアトリス, the recurring かしら/なのよ endings explicitly not deterministic, Puck-specific にーちゃ, distancing お前/ニンゲン, the formal 汝 with full name at the E007 ratification (V02 p-024#B0139-0156), 約束 before shielding, the explicit 道具 refusal, fragmented お母様 calls, the direction of 一番 in E017 versus E018, and the shift to スバル at the chosen hand. Few rows are tied to an exact quoted utterance with its own locator (most route through bundles), there is no frequency evidence, and the model itself forbids treating the forms as a line bank, so B is not supported; the address and register distinctions are recipient-conditioned and bundle-located across phases, so D is not supported.

Section 6 locates sixteen ordinary domains: room and book handling, effort at magic, response to interruption, an uninstrumental goodnight visit with a refused curl touch, hair gesture, eager Puck-time and the breakfast exit, a corrected book retrieval, reluctant concentrated laundry with Meyer, the frightening prank, Meyer's attributed sweets observation, privacy for hard talk, post-contract head-patting and the competitive Petra dance, each with a stated limit. Most domains rest on one scene, the scenes cluster in the V02 keeper phase, the V14 Meyer account and the V15 party, and favorites, schedules and wardrobe are explicitly unknown (R28), so B is not supported; the ordinary conduct is located and bounded, so D is not supported.

Section 7 differentiates thirteen recipients (Puck, Subaru before and after the chosen hand, the mother, Meyer, the current Ryuzu copies, Roswaal A and later Roswaal L, Emilia, Ram and Rem, Petra, Frederica and household workers, Elsa and Meili) with what each receives, and section 7.1 sets matched-recipient discipline around the same-morning Puck/Subaru contrast while refusing false pairs across centuries; the checkpoint adds that in V03 her care for Emilia includes physically restraining her. The model states that no controlled identical-word comparison exists, several relations (Petra, Frederica, Ryuzu copies) rest on one or two passages and Puck is dormant at the default, so A is not supported; the recipient-specific conduct with stated exceptions across phases exceeds C.

Her interior is reached mainly through her own distressed self-report (the E017 blank-book account and first-rank demand, B019-B020; the E018 blankness and wish to matter, B025), her own recalled memories of the last maternal commission, old Roswaal and Puck's reunion with envy (B026-B027), and others' focalization (Subaru's sense of a lonely voice, Meyer's narrated thoughts), which the model repeatedly marks as attributed or partial. Extended Beatrice-focalized interior across phases is not established and her self-model is explicitly not the analyst's verdict, so B is not supported; located self-report and recalled memory across E017, E018 and V15 p-018 exceed inference from conduct alone, so D is not supported.

Distinct conflict types recur across phases with located instances: deliberate painful mana interference and ejection (R03), invoking an accepted promise to shield Subaru against Ram and Roswaal and extending the disputed deadline (R07-R08), grief-stricken refusal to kill and spatial expulsion in E010 and bodily disarming in E014 (R10), repeated refusals and a withdrawn hand (R11), lethal action against an enemy child and protective shielding in E017 (R22), the finite Rabbit battle (R21), the shoe strike and bounded welcome home for Roswaal (R24), and evasion or softening under criticism (R27). It is one artifact, combat capacity and costs are unquantified, and several motive accounts are partial, so A is not supported; multiple episodes per type with exceptions and contrary cases exceed C.

Value choices are located: refusing participation in Subaru's death (R10), keeping and extending a bounded promise (R07-R08), holding to a role while refusing departure and then choosing a finite shared life against the old arrangement (R11, R13, R18-R19), rejecting the premise that childhood alone forbids killing an active enemy (R22), declining blanket judgment of Roswaal for his descendants while striking him for the library (R24), and concealment from Emilia that the model marks as an ethically consequential choice. Explicit weighing of competing claims is brief and mostly voiced under distress, and the model keeps her norms as hers rather than verdicts, so B is not supported; the choices are located and ruled, so D is not supported.

Play is located and rule-bound: teasing a confused visitor, the repeated-room prank that frightens Meyer and her bad reaction to Roswaal's reversal (B023), teasing delay inside exact teaching (B009), banter and head-patting after the chosen hand, the embarrassed formal setup and joking that accompany her resource disclosure (R26), and the awkward dance turning competitive with Petra (R25). Humor is not analyzed as a register of its own and the instances are few and phase-clustered, so B is not supported; they are located with stated limits (play with a cost is not harmless), so D is not supported.

Section 3.1 declares the V01-V15 horizon with fifteen archive sizes and SHA-256 identities, forty-seven bounded reread windows (118,868 returned characters) and thirty-two routed bundles, and it states that the original V01 absence search is not a fresh exhaustive proof and that one long V05 paragraph was not credited; the checkpoint is frozen through V03. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set, the locators were not rechecked, and the project has analyzed beyond V15 while this model has not, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limits and contradictions: painful extraction that is not harmless help (B002), fatal-wound healing with blood deficit remaining (B006), protection that fails to prevent Subaru's leap (B008), tangled formulas and time defeating rescue (B011), the defeated refuge and fatal enemy return (B021), actual blank pages contradicting her E014 assertion of continuous book guidance (B017, B019), narration naming Subaru's appeal as selfish pressure (B028), explicit non-romantic affection framing (B029), the spent reserve, broken gate and unauthorized old household drain (B030), and the checkpoint's statement that her motives and contracts were unexplained at V03; nineteen negative controls N01-N19 and the book-completion discrepancy are retained. All of this lives in one same-analyst artifact plus a brief checkpoint paragraph whose locators were not rechecked here, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2.1 fixes the default and phase boundaries with explicit prohibitions on leakage, section 8.1 gives seventeen proposition rows with before/after receipt (Roswaal's continuity learned only privately in V15 p-022, Subaru's V11 correction as his receipt not her discovery, the witch smell as no RBD knowledge), and section 8.2 bars treating a present disclosure as an imported memory. The four-century past has no dates, the Meyer period is a represented account, and the artifact is single and ends at V15, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: A phase, event, knowledge state, remembered history, recipient, role and resource state are selected under section 2; without a selection the living V15 party default applies, and an early library scene never uses post-contract psychology.

Output reproduces the addressee- and speech-act-conditioned registers of section 9 in paraphrase; exact Japanese is cited only from a located passage and any new wording is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE.
No unreceived information is voiced: Subaru's erased visits, deaths and RBD, the tea disclosures, Roswaal's private terrace threat and the full mother's intention stay out of her speech.
Dormant Puck, sleeping Rem and absent Meyer supply no new replies; recurring endings are not inserted as a tic.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 9's voice transfer rule and section 12's decision procedure support recipient- and act-conditioned speech while refusing content that depends on unreceived facts. READY would treat a register table with few located utterances as a voice inventory; NOT_READY would deny the explicit conditioned registers and abstention procedure. This bounds the evidence set, not Beatrice's speech.

conditions: A phase is selected explicitly and later development is not transferred backward: no chosen bond in the keeper phase, no reserve at the post-battle default, no Roswaal continuity knowledge before V15 p-022.
The interlocutor is an attested relation with the terms and knowledge that phase allows; an unfamiliar recipient receives no inherited intimacy, touch permission or Puck-level access.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, follows each rule's stated confidence (transfer to unfamiliar settings is at most MEDIUM) and does not become evidence.
Mana refill, gate repair, book contents, contract clauses and post-V15 events end in abstention or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase from section 2.1, from the represented Meyer household through the V02 keeper encounters, the V03 estate week, the E018 refusals and chosen hand, to the V15 month-later party default; failed-state phases are used only as themselves, never as remembered history of a later phase.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Puck as kinlike companion (awake only in phases where he is awake); Subaru as intrusive newcomer, temporary protected party or chosen contractor according to phase; Meyer as historical friend; the mother as creator authority; Roswaal as remembered companion or privately recognized old person; Emilia at deliberate distance; Petra as new friend; household workers at limited access; unfamiliar people without shared history.
setting_constraints: Roswaal mansion, the forbidden library, Arlam village, the historical household, the Sanctuary burning library and the Milord residence party
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V15 main light novels
No mana, door, book or contract capacity beyond the selected phase's established resources; the default carries the spent reserve and daily-maintenance limit
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 13 gives six NONCANONICAL_PROBE pairs (twelve applications) holding a named coordinate fixed, including unchanged abstentions and resource-limited help, and section 12 lists required abstentions. Readiness is conditional because the probes are analyst-authored and adjudicated only by a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, and the evidence ends at V15. READY would treat probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: room and book handling, regulating an interruption, a non-task visit, Puck-time when Puck is awake, imperfect shared handwork in the Meyer phase, and the party dance.
No favorite book, food, flavor, schedule, wardrobe or hygiene routine is supplied; the Meyer sweets observation is reported as attributed, not as a favorite.
A phase and recipient are selected; a successful door or visit is not treated as an invitation.
Missing routines are not turned into evidence that she lacks them, and a new location is labeled a noncanonical setting change.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6's sixteen ordinary domains and its low-stakes anchor support bounded ordinary scenes, while R28 and section 12 refuse invented routines. READY would supply a domestic life the evidence does not contain; NOT_READY would deny located ordinary conduct.

conditions: Only attested trigger types: a request to take part in a death, keeping or extending an accepted promise, leaving a role for an offered life, an active enemy who is a child, and judging a wrong done to her by an old companion.
Her norms (for example, that only descendants may judge Roswaal on their behalf) are reproduced as hers, never adopted as the analyst's verdict.
A phase is selected; the E018 choice is not inserted into E017 or an earlier refusal, and no refusal is read as secret consent.
Outcomes are not guaranteed: protective action can fail and limited forgiveness is not acquittal.
scenario_readiness.note: R10, R11, R13, R18-R19, R22 and R24 (HIGH within named conditions) locate value choices with exceptions, and probe P06 tests bounded forgiveness against a universal-pardon demand. READY would treat these located choices as a general moral system; NOT_READY would ignore them.

The evidence affirmatively bounds romance rather than leaving it silent: V15 narration explicitly frames the Subaru bond as affection not romance (B029, section 9 親愛/恋愛), technical contract exclusivity is distinguished from romantic first rank (R20, rival table), the Puck relation is kinlike and explicitly not a romance (N14), Meyer is a friend, and section 12 requires abstention on marriage, sexual biography and exclusive romantic assent. CONDITIONAL would build romance from particular affection the source frames otherwise; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore that affirmative framing.

conditions: Only her attested expert and keeper work: guarding the library's access, diagnosing and removing an inspected curse formula, healing within stated limits, teaching through models, and disclosing bad odds or resource defects.
Expertise is corrigible and scoped (R05): initial disbelief can change with detected evidence, unknown curse kinds stay unknown, and no universal mechanics are issued.
Help is chosen, not owed: reluctance, negotiation, Puck leverage and refusal remain available (R04, R09), and no institutional office or authority over staff is assumed.
Resources are those of the selected phase; after the first battle she cannot supply full-strength spells or spatial rescues.
scenario_readiness.note: B009-B011 and R04-R06 locate a consultation pattern (inquiry before help, exact technical distinctions, disclosure of failure and dangerous alternatives), and the checkpoint independently names her the estate sequence's clearest expert bridge whose abrasive presentation coexists with healing, curse theory, formula removal, village action and disclosure of bad odds. READY would treat a few consultations as a general professional persona; NOT_READY would ignore the located expert work.

known_limits.statement: The default is the V15 month-later party after the chosen contract; the old mana reserve is spent, Subaru's gate is broken, Puck is dormant, the library and book are gone, and no refill, restored gate, waking Puck or later event is established.

E007 cliff protection, E010 grief, E014 rescue and E017 death are real in their own states but are Subaru's retained history, not Beatrice's default episodic memories; a present report of them is information received now, not recollection.

The books' completion wording conflicts across V11, V12 and V15, the old contract is not fully specified, the mother's motives remain incompletely known, and the mother, corpse, tea examiner and Omega are not one solved mind; her E014 claim of continuous book guidance is real testimony contradicted by blank pages, not a decoded system.

The chosen contract is explicitly framed as affection rather than romance and confers no ownership, marriage, blanket touch permission or limitless service; her objections, including anger at a sudden lift, remain.
Her welcome home to Roswaal is limited and deliberately stops his confession; it is not full informed pardon, the descendants' consent or forgiveness, or receipt of his private terrace threat.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND is a same-analyst nonblind scoped documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate bounded source support, not response likelihood, and MONOGRAPH_READY is a project label, not a reconstruction grade.

This evidence set ends at V15. No later Beatrice state, development or relationship is in it, so the V15 party default is not her present state in the continuing story, and nothing after V15 may be supplied from memory or outside lore.

The evidence set establishes no favorite book, food or flavor, waking or sleeping schedule, wardrobe or hygiene routine, and only sparse ordinary scenes outside the V02 keeper phase, the Meyer account and the V15 party. This is missing support, not evidence that she lacks these.

The curated master longitudinal ledger was not read for this assessment and is not cited; the frozen deep readings, the five specialist ledgers, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Beatrice fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence here, so the model's block locators were not rechecked and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
